thread:
maria-support: Heads-up — multiple tenants reporting 502/503s on hosted inference since ~09:30UTC. Errors spike when session/auth calls go to routing-policy. Seen across regions us-west/us-east.

ashley-eng: Thanks — any sample request_id(s) or logs?

maria-support: sample req id: r-01f4b2c3. Logs show routing-policy call timing out then control-plane returning 502 to gateway. Snippet: 
```
[09:31:12] auth: request r-01f4b2c3 -> routing-policy (POST /decide) latency=1200ms 
[09:31:13] routing-policy: timeout after 1000ms, returning 504 -> propagated as 502 upstream
[09:31:14] gateway: 502 to tenant 87, model text-gen-v1
```

jordan-sre: alert fired: cp-deps-timeout-high at 09:30. Auto-retries hit rate limit so we see fanout of 502s. Looks like routing-policy and configdb backend SLOs breached.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3884 — assigned to eng-oncall.

ashley-eng: Reproduced locally by running a tight loop of inference requests while throttling routing-policy DB connections. Quick repro: 
```bash
for i in {1..500}; do \
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"text-gen-v1","input":"hello"}' \
    https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
 done
```
When conn pool exhausted routing-policy latencies spike and we hit 5xx waterfall.

kevin-platops: Noted two things: routing-policy timeout currently 1s; configdb client has default 10 connections per pod. Under high fanout that isn't enough. Proposal: bump routing-policy timeout to 2.5s and increase configdb pool in next deploy.

maria-support: Customers asking for mitigation now — can we enable immediate fallback? e.g., skip routing-policy for known trusted tenants or route to cached policy?

ashley-eng: We have a short-term toggle: env ROUTING_POLICY_CACHE_ENABLED=true which forces cached policy lookup on misses. Can flip for hosted tier for 15min while we scale. Doing a controlled flip for tenant-87 and tenant-102 to confirm behavior.

jordan-sre: Also enabling graceful retries at gateway layer with jitter backoff (2 retries) to avoid simultaneous retry storm. Watch CPU and token throughput.

maria-support: Customer-facing note drafted: "We're investigating a transient control-plane dependency issue causing intermittent 5xx; mitigation in progress (cache fallbacks + increased timeouts)." Will send after we confirm toggle works.

ashley-eng: Action items: 1) Flip ROUTING_POLICY_CACHE_ENABLED for hosted temporarily (ashley) 2) Increase routing-policy timeout to 2.5s and increase configdb pool to 30 connections (kevin) 3) Monitor error-rate and token latency on per-tenant dashboard (jordan).

kevin-platops: Started a canary change on two pods, routing-policy timeout set to 2500ms. Observing immediate drop in 5xx for canaryed tenants.

maria-support: Can confirm tenant-87 reports recovery. Will notify affected customers and keep thread updated. :white_check_mark: 

jordan-sre: Keep an eye on downstream cost impact but for now prioritizing availability. Will follow up with a postmortem and perf graphs.

ashley-eng: Leaving follow-up tasks for eng-runtime to add per-request circuit breaker on routing-policy RPCs and implement a stronger local TTL cache for policy decisions.

maria-support: Thanks team — escalating to leadership with current mitigation status and ETA for rollback to defaults after stability window.
